verdict.rationale: The official Codex CLI has plugin-specific features: a `codex plugin marketplace add` subcommand for adding and tracking marketplace sources, a `/plugins` browser for installing from configured marketplaces, and `/skills` / `$skill-installer` for skill management. Together these give AI-native users a first-party command-line path for working with plugins. missing for 10: a full CLI command reference (e.g. list/remove/update subcommands, non-interactive or scripted flags), and independent hands-on corroboration of the official CLI. The verified runtime install used third-party `npx skills`, not the official CLI.
